turns.assessment: The change is confined to telemetry at trx.och55.z: the optical-path monitors, amplifiers, opposite-end receiver, pre-FEC BER, DGD, and SOP metrics show no corresponding change. A real upstream power change of 5.5 dB should have appeared in downstream OCM/amplifier measurements or affected signal quality, while the documented path faults generally cause low or lost power rather than a persistent increase. This most strongly suggests an undocumented receiver telemetry/calibration anomaly; the listed RX_DEGRADATION mode is the nearest documented possibility but is not established because no receiver errors appeared.

proposals.rationale: Both changed measurements are generated at this receiver, while independent path telemetry and the far end are stable. However, documented RX_DEGRADATION should produce a receiver penalty or errors, and pre-FEC BER did not change.

A channel-specific WSS change near S17 could evade measurements taken before the WSS and affect only och55. It is unlikely because the documented fault increases attenuation and lowers power, opposite to the observed increase, and it would not naturally improve OSNR by the same amount.
Mechanical handling can cause an alarm-free power excursion, but it should be brief, affect all channels on the span, and normally be visible to other optical monitors.
proposals.note: nothing at that location documents the mode
